name: Deer
description: Deer are hoofed ruminant Mammals found in forests, grasslands and tundra across most of the world. $(br2)Common characteristics of deer include long, slender legs, large ears, and bony antlers in males, which are shed and regrown every year. $(br2)Deer are herbivores, browsing and grazing on leaves, shoots and grasses, and are important prey for many predators.
